posts.title: Clean a laptop without breaking it

slides.text:
Clean a laptop without breaking it
Power down and unplug first
Use compressed air in short bursts on vents
Wipe the lid with microfiber and isopropyl
Never spray liquid directly at ports or fans
Do it quarterly — dust is the silent throttler.
Save this — you'll need it next time.
